t: This artwork is called Beyond the Deepening Shadow. It was an installation at the Tower of London in November 2018, made to mark the centenary of the end of the First World War. It was created by Tom Piper, a British theatre designer who became an associate designer with the Royal Shakespeare Company in 2004. He often worked with the director Michael Boyd. The installation was a temporary commemoration, so what you see now is the setting where it stood, with the Tower around you.
